title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
notes: Time budget: Civilization VI normally outlasts a Trial, so keep live 10800-second language-model and 3600-second Jev budgets. Science-v1 retains its historical Deity condition. The Prince development condition was accepted on 2026-10-29; science-route-v3 carries forward that explicitly labeled condition and the same prepared snapshot for retroactive reuse, rather than claiming a new Deity run. Only Science Victory is enabled. Native checkpoint completeness, player attribution and charged-budget guards remain required.
introduction: Sid Meier’s Civilization VI: Gathering Storm is a turn-based empire-building game. The prepared game uses an Ancient Era Aztec start with one AI opponent and only Science Victory enabled. Science-v1 trials use Deity difficulty; development-v2 trials use Prince difficulty. Victory requires the native expedition to reach its destination. Defeat occurs if the human civilization is eliminated or another team wins. Gameplay starts from a fixed undeveloped save after one documented preparation turn.
controls: Use left clicks to select units, cities, menu entries and map tiles. Right clicks issue map orders for a selected unit. M selects the move command, which can then be targeted with a left click. The arrow keys pan the map. The configured input profile supplies ordinary keyboard and pointer controls, using fixed points or native Box targets as declared by that profile. Units, research and production choices use the game's visible controls. The game waits for player input between turns; no process pause is used.
